competences.description: Attacks all enemies and grants a different harmful effect on each use. On the first use, leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns. On the second use, decreases the Attack Bar by 30%. From the third use onward, stuns the target for 1 turn with a 50% chance.
Increases the boss's Attack Bar by 35% each time an enemy's turn ends. [Automatic Effect]
Recovers 10% of the boss's HP and reduces the duration of harmful effects on the boss by 1 turn at the start of its turn. [Automatic Effect]
